method: Built-in image_gen, three independent reference-guided title compositions, then one localized correction each (corrections.json). Generated 2026-10-01; DEV comparison implemented; user not satisfied with title-to-game continuity. Not production-selected.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished independent pixel-art game title background, landscape 1536x1024 (3:2). Reference 1 is the approved original art: preserve its exquisite pixel texture, lonely human scale, deep gigantic ruined library and restrained darkness, not its exact layout. Reference 2 is the actual game and governs the identity of its helmeted backpack survivor, cast-iron furnace, broken architectural bench, ash-grey stone and dark metal; ignore the UI. Reference 3 is the actual containment core: tapered open iron restraining ribs around a floating volumetric pale cold grey-green pollutant energy mass, not a portal or lamp.
VERSION A: A PLACE ONE CAN STILL STAY. Independent evocative composition, no complete base floorplan or diorama. Right foreground, an exhausted helmeted lone adult in charcoal ochre-grey work clothes and heavy boots sits naturally, elbows loosely on knees, on a fallen stone lintel still embedded in the old architecture. A small cast-iron furnace stands a credible arm-and-leg distance in front, its slotted firebox gives a precious restrained ember-amber pool on hands, stone and boots. Small warm shoulder lamp. Behind/right, the recognizable containment core remains the strongest environmental light source, shining desaturated cold grey-green on broken stone and surviving shelves. A massive surviving pier at the right supports the place; this is not a floating island. The ledge fades into a colossal dark ruined library abyss with tilted arches, unsupported library wall fragments, hanging bookcases, fractured load-bearing beams. Depth from near detailed black silhouettes through partially legible structures to barely visible far shapes. The seated person and familiar furnace are the emotional anchor; enormous world dwarfs them. Let the diagonal ruined edge conduct the eye toward the person; varied masses, not repetitive columns. Show beautiful layered structural sections, contact shadows, chipped mineral edges, rough soot metal and aged books with purposeful clustered pixels, exquisite middle-scale description, not procedural speckle.
Left 30% deliberately quiet low-contrast shadow/atmosphere for title/menu; especially normalized x .08-.34 y .27-.60 clear of bright objects. Still subtly atmospheric, not flat black rectangle. Main subjects in right 60%. All scene fills frame naturally with ledge continuing off right/bottom. Camera a carefully composed elevated oblique cinematic pixel illustration, not orthographic gameplay screenshot. Dark neutral charcoal, stone grey, dusty desaturated textiles; disciplined small amber and cold contaminated green illumination. NO broad blue fill, no lush green, no healthy vegetation, no sun/sky, no neon outlines, no stars, no decorative magic runes. Painterly richness achieved with sharply intentional pixel clusters, consistent hard pixel scale; no glossy photoreal/3D render, no vector drawing, no blurry painting. This is mature finished game key art with material volume and rich but organized detail. Only one person; no enemies, weapons pointed, extra invented machines, HUD, text, lettering, watermark, borders, triptych. Preserve a solemn fragile refuge, not cozy tavern. Render the entire finished image.
